productRequirement.summary: Build a new Northstar API Keys management experience that does not already exist in the repository. Workspace admins need to browse and search keys, create a key with an access scope, inspect key metadata, and revoke a key with confirmation.
userGoals: Browse API keys with name/prefix identity, access scope, status, and a record-specific details action.
Search keys by name or key prefix.
Create a key with a required display name and one access scope: Read only or Read and write.
Inspect key details including name, prefix, scope, status, created by, and created date.
Revoke an active key only after an explicit consequential confirmation.
dataFixtures: Production deploy — prefix nsk_prod_7H2 — Read and write — Active — created by Amal Hassan.
Analytics reader — prefix nsk_analytics_4F9 — Read only — Active — created by Sara Ahmed.
Legacy integration — prefix nsk_legacy_2K1 — Read only — Revoked — created by Amal Hassan.
API key prefixes are intrinsically LTR even when the surrounding UI is Arabic.
This evaluation does not require revealing, copying, or storing an actual secret token value.
requiredStates: Create-key modal with validation and successful creation.
Key detail open with selected-row association.
presentationModes: Wide Application Shell and compact/narrow directory presentation.
For any contextual-detail behavior that approved guidance marks unresolved on narrow screens, report the unresolved decision instead of inventing a new model.
